headline: The power of the sun. Smarter energy for everyday life.

trust: From planning to installation – your energy solution, coordinated
introtext: A well-designed solar system can help make energy costs more predictable over the long term. SOLARIS focuses on tailored solutions shaped around your property, consumption habits and goals.
services: Everything you need to make the most of solar power
service_intro: From the initial assessment to ongoing checks, we help identify the solution that fits your needs.
s1t: Make the most of your roof space. Solar systems for homes and businesses, designed around the characteristics of each property.
s2t: Store part of the energy you generate for later use. Battery solutions designed to give you greater flexibility.
s3t: Combine solar generation, energy storage and grid supply in a system tailored to your requirements.
s4t: We assess consumption, roof conditions and technical requirements to help you understand the available options.

solutions: Three system concepts. One goal: smarter energy.
on_text: Use the electricity generated by your panels directly, with the grid supplying any additional power you need.
off_text: A solution designed for independent energy supply, with appropriately sized storage based on the site's requirements.
hy_text: Combining solar generation, battery storage and grid power can provide greater flexibility.
benefits: Energy solutions built on thoughtful decisions
b1t: No one-size-fits-all approach. Your building and energy use shape the system concept.
b2t: Clear guidance on the options, technical solutions and the steps ahead.
b3t: System components are selected to suit the intended use and the overall design.
b4t: We consider not only installation, but also everyday use and future maintenance.
process: Four steps towards your energy solution
p1t: We learn about your energy use, property and objectives.
p2t: We develop a suitable system concept and explain the technical options.
p3t: Our team carries out the installation and required configuration based on the approved plan.
p4t: We explain how to use the system and discuss future checks and support.
gallery: Solar power can work in many different ways
gallerytext: Family homes, commercial properties and larger installations – every project is different, with the same aim: making better use of renewable energy.
faq: What should you know about solar systems?
q1: Can solar panels be installed on every roof?
a1: Not every roof is suitable in the same way. Orientation, pitch, shading, structure and local requirements all need to be assessed.
a2: It depends on your consumption habits, system size and when you use electricity. Comparing options during planning is recommended.
a3: The timeframe depends on system size, property conditions and any required approvals or grid procedures.
q4: Do you provide solutions for businesses?
a4: Yes. Tailored system concepts can be developed for industrial, commercial and office properties.
